name: io.github.agentsearchhq-coder/agentsearch-mcp
title: AgentSearch (agentsearchhq.com)
description: Free web search + extract/render trial (no key), then pay per call via x402 on Base.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated wallet with a little USDC on Base; enables paid extract/render via x402, paid to AgentSearch's own API by default (extract $0.004, render $0.010, search_and_read $0.009). Without it, extract/render use the free trial (5/3 calls per day per IP). Search stays free unless AGENTSEARCH_MODE=paid. Alias: POCKET_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Search mode: free (default; free relay even with a wallet key), paid (pay per search, $0.008 direct or $0.005 via Pocket; needs a key) or auto (paid search when a key is set)

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_FREE_TRIAL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to turn off the no-wallet extract/render free trial (then no-wallet extract/render make no network call). Default on

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_PAYMENT_ROUTE
environmentVariables.description: Paid route: direct (default since 1.6.0; AgentSearch's own x402 API on Base, search $0.008, extract $0.004, render $0.010, search_and_read $0.009) or pocket (Pocket Network Agentic Portal, $0.005 per call)

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_X402_DIRECT
environmentVariables.description: Legacy 1.5.0 switch: 0 selects the Pocket route (same as AGENTSEARCH_PAYMENT_ROUTE=pocket). Direct is already the default since 1.6.0

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_MAX_TOTAL_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Session spend cap in USDC atomic units (default 1000000 = $1.00). Alias: POCKET_MAX_TOTAL_ATOMIC

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_MAX_PER_CALL_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Optional lower per-call cap in USDC atomic units (hard max 20000 = $0.020 on the default direct route, 5000 = $0.005 on the Pocket route)

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional self-hosted AgentSearch API base URL; when set, search/extract/render use it with no payment

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Bearer token for your AgentSearch API

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSEARCH_REVIEW_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Review Board key for weighted reviews
